words.gloss: at the junctions of the country (frontiers)
to the neighbouring princes, forest chiefs, his (the enemy's) kinsmen and the disgraced
preceded by (gifts of) goods and dwellings

hindi: और उसके जो गुप्तचर दुर्गों में व्यापारी के वेष में, गाँवों में गृहपति के वेष में और जनपद की सीमाओं पर गोरक्षक और तापस के वेष में रहते हैं, वे सामन्तों, आटविकों, उसके कुलीनों और अपरुद्धों के पास पहले पण्य और आगार भेजकर यह सन्देश भेजें कि "यह देश हरण करने योग्य है"।
english: And those agents of his (the weaker king) who are in the forts disguised as traders, in the villages disguised as householders, and at the frontiers of the country disguised as cowherds and ascetics, should send word to the neighbouring princes, the forest chieftains, the kinsmen of that (enemy) and princes in disfavour, preceded by (gifts of) goods and dwellings: "This country can be seized."

text_flags.why: loc. pl. of grāma needs retroflex ṣ (ṣatva after e); typing error

notes: asya taken as the weaker king (subject of Book 12); tat-kulīna = kinsmen of the enemy. paṇya-āgāra-pūrvam is read as an adverb: 'with goods and dwellings sent first', i.e. inducements; an alternative is 'under the pretext of a warehouse'. vaidehakavyañjanāḥ is printed without the compound dot; no change needed.
lines_deva: ये च-अस्य दुर्गेषु वैदेहकव्यञ्जनाः, ग्रामेसु गृहपतिक.व्यञ्जनाः, जन.पद.सन्धिषु गो.रक्षक.तापस.व्यञ्जनाः, ते सामन्त.आटविक.तत्.कुलीन.अपरुद्धानां पण्य.आगार.पूर्वं प्रेषयेयुः "अयं देशो हार्यः" इति
lines_iast: ye ca-asya durgeṣu vaidehakavyañjanāḥ, grāmesu gṛhapatika.vyañjanāḥ, jana.pada.sandhiṣu go.rakṣaka.tāpasa.vyañjanāḥ, te sāmanta.āṭavika.tat.kulīna.aparuddhānāṃ paṇya.āgāra.pūrvaṃ preṣayeyuḥ "ayaṃ deśo hāryaḥ" iti

words.gloss: weak points of the constituent elements

hindi: और इनके जो गूढ़ पुरुष दुर्ग में आयें, उनका धन और मान से सत्कार करके वे उन्हें प्रकृतियों के छिद्र दिखायें।
english: And having honoured with wealth and honour the secret agents of these (neighbours etc.) who have come into the fort, they should show them the weak points of the (enemy's) constituent elements.
notes: prakṛtic.chidrāṇi: the e-text keeps the sandhi t > c before ch; underlying prakṛti-chidrāṇi.
lines_deva: आगतांश् च-एषां दुर्गे गूढ.पुरुषान् अर्थ.मानाभ्याम् अभिसत्कृत्य प्रकृतिच्.छिद्राणि प्रदर्शयेयुः
lines_iast: āgatāṃś ca-eṣāṃ durge gūḍha.puruṣān artha.mānābhyām abhisatkṛtya prakṛtic.chidrāṇi pradarśayeyuḥ

hindi: उन छिद्रों पर वे उनके साथ मिलकर प्रहार करें।
english: They should strike at those (weak points) together with them.
lines_deva: तेषु तैः सह प्रहरेयुः
lines_iast: teṣu taiḥ saha prahareyuḥ

words.gloss: at the time of an assault

hindi: अथवा उसके स्कन्धावार में शौण्डिक के वेष में रहने वाला गुप्तचर किसी अभित्यक्त पुरुष को अपना पुत्र बनाकर रखे, आक्रमण के समय उसे विष से मरवा दे, और "नैषेचनिक" कहकर मदन-रस से युक्त सैकड़ों मद्य के घड़े बाँटे।
english: Or in his (the enemy's) camp an agent disguised as a liquor-seller, having set up a condemned man as his son and having done away with him with poison at the time of an assault, should give out hundreds of jars of liquor mixed with madana-juice, saying "this is the funeral libation."
notes: pravāsayitvā is the text's euphemism for 'having had him killed'. naiṣecanikam: a drink-offering given on the occasion of a death; rendering 'funeral libation' is interpretive. madana: a plant used as poison here; name kept. The hyphen in madyakumbhān-śataśaḥ marks an unsandhied join (print has sandhi).
lines_deva: स्कन्ध.आवारे वा-अस्य शौण्डिक.व्यञ्जनः पुत्रम् अभित्यक्तं स्थापयित्वा-अवस्कन्द.काले रसेन प्रवासयित्वा "नैषेचनिकम्" इति मदन.रस.युक्तान् मद्यकुम्भान्-शतशः प्रयच्छेत्
lines_iast: skandha.āvāre vā-asya śauṇḍika.vyañjanaḥ putram abhityaktaṃ sthāpayitvā-avaskanda.kāle rasena pravāsayitvā "naiṣecanikam" iti madana.rasa.yuktān madyakumbhān-śataśaḥ prayacchet

hindi: अथवा वह एक दिन शुद्ध मद्य या चौथाई मिलाया हुआ मद्य दे, और उसके बाद विष से सिद्ध मद्य दे।
english: Or he should give pure liquor, or liquor mixed by a quarter, for one day, and afterwards give out (liquor) prepared with poison.

text_flags.why: stem form ras- does not exist; the parallel in 12.4.6 reads rasa.siddhaṃ; typing error

notes: pādyam is uncertain: taken as 'with a quarter part (of poison or of some admixture)'; it could also mean liquor given as a quarter share or at a quarter price.
lines_deva: शुद्धं वा मद्यं पाद्यं वा मद्यं दद्याद् एकम् अहः, उत्तरं रस्.सिद्धं प्रयच्छेत्
lines_iast: śuddhaṃ vā madyaṃ pādyaṃ vā madyaṃ dadyād ekam ahaḥ, uttaraṃ ras.siddhaṃ prayacchet

words.gloss: to the chiefs of the army

hindi: अथवा सेना के मुख्यों को शुद्ध मद्य देकर, नशे के समय विष से सिद्ध मद्य दे।
english: Or having given pure liquor to the chiefs of the army, he should give out (liquor) prepared with poison at the time of their intoxication.
lines_deva: शुद्धं वा मद्यं दण्ड.मुख्येभ्यः प्रदाय मद.काले रस.सिद्धं प्रयच्छेत्
lines_iast: śuddhaṃ vā madyaṃ daṇḍa.mukhyebhyaḥ pradāya mada.kāle rasa.siddhaṃ prayacchet

hindi: अथवा सेना-मुख्य के वेष में रहने वाला गुप्तचर "अभित्यक्त पुरुष को पुत्र बनाकर" इत्यादि वही उपाय करे।
english: Or (for an agent) disguised as an army chief, the procedure is the same as stated: "a condemned man (set up) as his son".
lines_deva: दण्ड.मुख्य.व्यञ्जनो वा पुत्रम् अभित्यक्तम् इति समानम्
lines_iast: daṇḍa.mukhya.vyañjano vā putram abhityaktam iti samānam

words.gloss: disguised as sellers of cooked meat, of cooked rice, of auṇḍika-food and of cakes

hindi: अथवा पके मांस, पके भात, औण्डिक और पूए बेचने वालों के वेष में रहने वाले गुप्तचर विशेष पण्य की घोषणा करके, आपसी होड़ से "उधार पर" या "अधिक सस्ता" कहकर शत्रुओं को बुलाकर अपने पण्य को विष से दूषित कर दें।
english: Or agents disguised as sellers of cooked meat, of cooked rice, of auṇḍika-food and of cakes, having proclaimed special goods and, through mutual rivalry, saying "on credit" or "cheaper", having called in the enemies, should spoil their own goods with poison.
notes: pākva-māṃsika: taddhita -ika on the compound pakva-māṃsa with vṛddhi of the first syllable (like audanika, āpūpika), 'dealer in cooked meat'; the printed pākva is correct. auṇḍika: seller of some cooked food (uṇḍa?), exact meaning uncertain; name kept. kālikam taken as sale on time (credit); 'for the occasion / for a limited time' is an equally possible sense.
lines_deva: पाक्व.मांसिक.औदनिक.औण्डिक.आपूपिक.व्यञ्जना वा पण्य.विशेषम् अवघोषयित्वा परस्पर.सङ्घर्षेण कालिकं समर्घतरम् इति वा परान् आहूय रसेन स्व.पण्यान्य् अपचारयेयुः
lines_iast: pākva.māṃsika.audanika.auṇḍika.āpūpika.vyañjanā vā paṇya.viśeṣam avaghoṣayitvā paraspara.saṅgharṣeṇa kālikaṃ samarghataram iti vā parān āhūya rasena sva.paṇyāny apacārayeyuḥ

words.gloss: liquor, milk, curds, ghee and oils
in the hands of the dealers in them

hindi: अथवा स्त्रियाँ और बालक सुरा, दूध, दही, घी और तेल उनके व्यापारियों के हाथ से लेकर विष से युक्त अपने पात्रों में डालें।
english: Or women and children, having received liquor, milk, curds, ghee and oils in the hands of (i.e. from) the dealers in them, should pour them into their own vessels containing poison.

text_flags.why: possible: nom. pl. f. agreeing with striyaḥ needs the visarga, which sandhi keeps before s- (gṛhītāḥ striyo); the print has none

notes: gṛhītā(ḥ) agrees with striyaḥ ('women who have received') though logically the goods are what is received; the sentence is loose but the sense is clear. sarpis- keeps its final s in the compound as printed. The printed gṛhītā has no visarga though one is expected before striyaḥ; read as gṛhītāḥ and flagged.
lines_deva: सुरा.क्षीर.दधि.सर्पिस्.तैलानि वा तद्.व्यवहर्तृ.हस्तेषु गृहीता स्त्रियो बालाश् च रस.युक्तेषु स्व.भाजनेषु परिकिरेयुः
lines_iast: surā.kṣīra.dadhi.sarpis.tailāni vā tad.vyavahartṛ.hasteṣu gṛhītā striyo bālāś ca rasa.yukteṣu sva.bhājaneṣu parikireyuḥ

hindi: "इसी दाम पर, या इससे अच्छा फिर से दो" कहकर वे उसे वहीं उड़ेल दें।
english: Saying "at this price, or let something better be given again," they should pour it back right there (into the dealer's stock).
lines_deva: "अनेन-अर्घेण, विशिष्टं वा भूयो दीयताम्" इति तत्र-एव-अवाकिरेयुः
lines_iast: "anena-argheṇa, viśiṣṭaṃ vā bhūyo dīyatām" iti tatra-eva-avākireyuḥ

hindi: ये ही कार्य व्यापारी के वेष में रहने वाले गुप्तचर करें, अथवा पण्य के विक्रय के द्वारा माल लाने वाले करें।
english: These same (acts should be done by) agents disguised as traders, or by those who bring (goods) by way of selling goods.

text_flags.why: possible: vireya is no known word; vikraya 'sale' fits 'by the sale of goods'

notes: The verb is understood from the preceding sentences (should do). The reading vireyeṇa is doubtful; translated on the assumption vikrayeṇa.
lines_deva: एतान्य् एव वैदेहक.व्यञ्जनाः, पण्य.विरेयेण-आहर्तारो वा
lines_iast: etāny eva vaidehaka.vyañjanāḥ, paṇya.vireyeṇa-āhartāro vā

hindi: समीप रहने वाले गुप्तचर हाथियों और घोड़ों के आहार और चारे में विष डाल दें।
english: Those stationed near (the enemy) should put poison into the feed and fodder of elephants and horses.
notes: vidhā = prepared food given to animals; yavasa = grass fodder.
lines_deva: हस्त्य्.अश्वानां विधा.यवसेषु रसम् आसन्ना दद्युः
lines_iast: hasty.aśvānāṃ vidhā.yavaseṣu rasam āsannā dadyuḥ

hindi: अथवा मजदूरों के वेष में रहने वाले गुप्तचर विष लगा हुआ चारा या पानी बेचें।
english: Or agents disguised as labourers should sell fodder or water smeared with poison.
lines_deva: कर्म.कर.व्यञ्जना वा रस.अक्तं यवसम् उदकं वा विक्रीणीरन्
lines_iast: karma.kara.vyañjanā vā rasa.aktaṃ yavasam udakaṃ vā vikrīṇīran

words.gloss: at the times of an assault
of horses, donkeys, camels, buffaloes and the like

hindi: अथवा लम्बे समय से मिले-जुले रहने वाले गो-व्यापारी आक्रमण के समयों में शत्रुओं के मोह-स्थानों में गायों या बकरियों-भेड़ों के झुण्ड छोड़ दें, और घोड़ों, गधों, ऊँटों, भैंसों आदि में से दुष्ट पशु भी छोड़ दें।
english: Or cattle-traders long associated (with the enemy's people) should, at the times of an assault, let loose herds of cattle or of goats and sheep in the enemies' places of confusion, and also vicious ones among horses, donkeys, camels, buffaloes and the like.
notes: uṣṭramahiṣa is printed without the compound dot between uṣṭra and mahiṣa; no change needed. moha-sthāna: 'places of bewilderment', i.e. where the release would cause confusion.
lines_deva: चिर.संसृष्टा वा गो.वाणिजका गवाम् अज.अवीनां वा यूथान्य् अवस्कन्द.कालेषु परेषां मोह.स्थानेषु प्रमुञ्चेयुः, अश्व.खर.उष्ट्रमहिष.आदीनां दुष्टांश् च
lines_iast: cira.saṃsṛṣṭā vā go.vāṇijakā gavām aja.avīnāṃ vā yūthāny avaskanda.kāleṣu pareṣāṃ moha.sthāneṣu pramuñceyuḥ, aśva.khara.uṣṭramahiṣa.ādīnāṃ duṣṭāṃś ca

words.gloss: (animals) whose eyes are smeared with the blood of a musk-rat

hindi: अथवा उनके वेष में रहने वाले गुप्तचर छछूँदर के रक्त से आँखें लिपे हुए पशु छोड़ें।
english: Or (agents) disguised as them should (let loose animals) whose eyes are smeared with the blood of a musk-rat.
notes: Elliptical: the verb pramuñceyuḥ and the animals are understood from 12.4.14. cucchundarī = musk-shrew / musk-rat.
lines_deva: तद्.व्यञ्जना वा चुच्छुन्दरी.शोणित.अक्त.अक्षान्
lines_iast: tad.vyañjanā vā cucchundarī.śoṇita.akta.akṣān

hindi: अथवा शिकारियों के वेष में रहने वाले गुप्तचर पिंजरों से हिंसक पशु छोड़ दें, या सँपेरे उग्र विष वाले साँप छोड़ें, या हाथियों से जीविका चलाने वाले हाथी छोड़ दें।
english: Or agents disguised as hunters should release wild beasts from cages, or snake-catchers (release) snakes of fierce venom, or those who live by elephants (release) elephants.
lines_deva: लुब्धक.व्यञ्जना वा व्याल.मृगान् पञ्जरेभ्यः प्रमुञ्चेयुः, सर्प.ग्राहा वा सर्पान् उग्र.विषान्, हस्ति.जीविनो वा हस्तिनः
lines_iast: lubdhaka.vyañjanā vā vyāla.mṛgān pañjarebhyaḥ pramuñceyuḥ, sarpa.grāhā vā sarpān ugra.viṣān, hasti.jīvino vā hastinaḥ

hindi: अथवा अग्नि से जीविका चलाने वाले आग लगा दें।
english: Or those who live by fire should let loose fire.
lines_deva: अग्नि.जीविनो वा-अग्निम् अवसृजेयुः
lines_iast: agni.jīvino vā-agnim avasṛjeyuḥ

words.gloss: the chiefs of infantry, cavalry, chariots and elephants

hindi: अथवा गूढ़ पुरुष पैदल, घुड़सवार, रथ और हाथी सेना के मुख्यों को, जब वे विमुख हों, मार डालें, या मुख्यों के आवासों में आग लगा दें।
english: Or secret agents should strike down the chiefs of the infantry, cavalry, chariots and elephants when they are turned away (off guard), or should set fire to the quarters of the chiefs.
notes: vimukha: 'with face turned away', i.e. unaware or in retreat; both senses possible.
lines_deva: गूढ.पुरुषा वा विमुखान् पत्त्य्.अश्व.रथ.द्विप.मुख्यान् अभिहन्युः, आदीपयेयुर् वा मुख्य.आवासान्
lines_iast: gūḍha.puruṣā vā vimukhān patty.aśva.ratha.dvipa.mukhyān abhihanyuḥ, ādīpayeyur vā mukhya.āvāsān

words.gloss: appearing as the treasonable, enemies and forest chieftains

hindi: अथवा दूष्यों, अमित्रों और आटविकों के वेष में पहले से नियुक्त किये गये गुप्तचर पीछे से प्रहार करें या आक्रमण का प्रतिग्रह करें।
english: Or agents planted (beforehand) in the guise of the treasonable, of enemies and of forest chieftains should make an attack in the rear or receive (meet) an assault.
notes: avaskanda-pratigraha: 'reception of an assault', i.e. meeting or withstanding it; pratigraha can also mean a reserve force.
lines_deva: दूष्य.अमित्र.आटविक.व्यञ्जनाः प्रणिहिताः पृष्ठ.अभिघातम् अवस्कन्द.प्रतिग्रहं वा कुर्युः
lines_iast: dūṣya.amitra.āṭavika.vyañjanāḥ praṇihitāḥ pṛṣṭha.abhighātam avaskanda.pratigrahaṃ vā kuryuḥ

hindi: अथवा वन में छिपे हुए सीमान्त की सैन्य-टुकड़ी को बाहर खींचकर उस पर प्रहार करें, या एक ही मार्ग पर रसद, आसार और चारा लाने वाले दलों पर प्रहार करें।
english: Or (agents) hidden in the forest, having drawn out the frontier contingent, should strike it down, or (strike) on a single path (a narrow road) the supply trains, the reinforcements and the foraging parties.
notes: skandha here = a body of troops. vīvadha = supply convoy; āsāra = reinforcing force (glossary: reinforcer); prasāra = foraging party.
lines_deva: वन.गूढा वा प्रत्यन्त.स्कन्धम् उपनिष्कृष्य-अभिहन्युः, एक.अयने वीवध.आसार.प्रसारान् वा
lines_iast: vana.gūḍhā vā pratyanta.skandham upaniṣkṛṣya-abhihanyuḥ, eka.ayane vīvadha.āsāra.prasārān vā

hindi: अथवा रात्रि-युद्ध में पूर्व-संकेत के अनुसार बहुत से तूर्य बजाकर वे कहें: "हम घुस गये हैं, राज्य ले लिया गया है।"
english: Or in a night battle, by a pre-arranged signal, having sounded many war-instruments, they should say: "We have entered; the kingdom is taken."
lines_deva: ससङ्केतं वा रात्रि.युद्धे भूरि.तूर्यम् आहत्य ब्रूयुः "अनुप्रविष्टाः स्मो, लब्धं राज्यम्" इति
lines_iast: sasaṅketaṃ vā rātri.yuddhe bhūri.tūryam āhatya brūyuḥ "anupraviṣṭāḥ smo, labdhaṃ rājyam" iti

hindi: अथवा राजा के आवास में घुसकर वे कोलाहल के बीच राजा को मार डालें।
english: Or having entered the king's quarters, they should kill the king in the tumults.
lines_deva: राज.आवासम् अनुप्रविष्टा वा सङ्कुलेषु राजानं हन्युः
lines_iast: rāja.āvāsam anupraviṣṭā vā saṅkuleṣu rājānaṃ hanyuḥ

words.gloss: rangers of the mleccha, forest and army (troops)
relying on an enclosure of posts

hindi: अथवा जब वह बाहर निकल चुका हो, तब म्लेच्छ, आटविक और सेना के साथ चलने वाले योद्धा घात-स्थान का आश्रय लेकर या खंभों की बाड़ का आश्रय लेकर उसे चारों ओर से मार डालें।
english: Or when he has marched out, troops of mlecchas, forest tribes and the army, relying on an ambush or relying on an enclosure of posts, should kill him from all sides.

text_flags.why: daṇṭa is no word; daṇḍa 'army' is used throughout the chapter (daṇḍa.mukhya); typing error

notes: (eva?) is the editors' doubt mark; eva taken as emphatic 'him indeed' and left out of the translation as untranslatable emphasis. sattra: a concealed station / ambush; stambha-vāṭa: an enclosure or palisade of posts; both renderings are tentative.
lines_deva: सर्वतो वा प्रयातम् एनं (एव?) म्लेच्छ.आटविक.दण्ट.चारिणः सत्त्र.अपाश्रयाः स्तम्भ.वाट.अपाश्रया वा हन्युः
lines_iast: sarvato vā prayātam enaṃ (eva?) mleccha.āṭavika.daṇṭa.cāriṇaḥ sattra.apāśrayāḥ stambha.vāṭa.apāśrayā vā hanyuḥ

words.gloss: in the tumults of an assault
with the means of secret warfare

hindi: अथवा शिकारियों के वेष में रहने वाले गुप्तचर आक्रमण की भगदड़ में गूढ़ युद्ध के साधनों से उस पर प्रहार करें।
english: Or agents disguised as hunters should strike (him) in the tumults of an assault with the means of secret warfare.
lines_deva: लुब्धक.व्यञ्जना वा-अवस्कन्द.सङ्कुलेषु गूढ.युद्ध.हेतुभिर् अभिहन्युः
lines_iast: lubdhaka.vyañjanā vā-avaskanda.saṅkuleṣu gūḍha.yuddha.hetubhir abhihanyuḥ

words.gloss: in (a place) with rock, post-enclosure, mire or water in between
with a force (strong) on its own ground

hindi: अथवा एक ही मार्ग पर, या चट्टान, खंभों की बाड़, दलदल या बीच में पानी वाले स्थान पर, वे अपनी भूमि की सेना से प्रहार करें।
english: Or on a single path, or in a place with rock, an enclosure of posts, mire, or water in between, they should strike with a force on its own ground.
notes: khañjana is uncertain: taken as 'mire / ground that makes one limp'; the five members may be read as separate alternatives of terrain. sva-bhūmi-bala: a force fighting on terrain of its own choice.
lines_deva: एक.अयने वा शैल.स्तम्भ.वाट.खञ्जन.अन्तर्.उदके वा स्व.भूमि.बलेन-अभिहन्युः
lines_iast: eka.ayane vā śaila.stambha.vāṭa.khañjana.antar.udake vā sva.bhūmi.balena-abhihanyuḥ

words.gloss: with the rush (of water) from breaching the embankment of a river, lake or tank

hindi: अथवा नदी, सरोवर या तालाब के बाँध को तोड़कर उसके वेग से उसे डुबो दें।
english: Or they should flood (him) with the rush of water from breaching the embankment of a river, a lake or a tank.
lines_deva: नदी.सरस्.तटाक.सेतु.बन्ध.भेद.वेगेन वा प्लावयेयुः
lines_iast: nadī.saras.taṭāka.setu.bandha.bheda.vegena vā plāvayeyuḥ

words.gloss: (him) stationed in a desert fort, a forest fort or a low-lying (water) fort

hindi: अथवा धान्वन दुर्ग, वन दुर्ग या निम्न दुर्ग में स्थित उसको योग से उत्पन्न अग्नि और धूम से नष्ट कर दें।
english: Or (him) stationed in a desert fort, a forest fort or a low-lying fort, they should destroy with fire and smoke produced by secret contrivance (yoga).
notes: yoga here = secret contrivance, not 'acquisition' as in 6.2. nimna-durga: a fort in low ground, usually one protected by water.
lines_deva: धान्वन.वन.दुर्ग.निम्न.दुर्गस्थं वा योग.अग्नि.धूमाभ्यां नाशयेयुः
lines_iast: dhānvana.vana.durga.nimna.durgasthaṃ vā yoga.agni.dhūmābhyāṃ nāśayeyuḥ

hindi: तीक्ष्ण पुरुष संकट-स्थान में गये हुए को अग्नि से, मरुभूमि में गये हुए को धुएँ से, निधान में गये हुए को विष से, पानी में उतरे हुए को दुष्ट ग्राहों से या पानी में चलने वालों से मार डालें, अथवा जलते हुए आवास से निकलते हुए को मार डालें।
english: Assassins (tīkṣṇa) should finish him off with fire when he has gone into a narrow place, with smoke when he has gone into a desert, with poison when he has gone into a store-room, with vicious crocodiles or with men moving in the water when he has plunged into water, or (kill him) as he rushes out from his burning quarters.
notes: nidhāna-gata: 'in a place of deposit', a store-room or hidden chamber; sense tentative. ādīpta-āvāsāt: the printed ādīpta.āvāsān is the ablative with final t > n before niṣpatantam (sandhi kept in the e-text).
lines_deva: सङ्कट.गतम् अग्निना, धान्वन.गतं धूमेन, निधान.गतं रसेन, तोय.अवगाढं दुष्ट.ग्राहैर् उदक.चरणैर् वा तीक्ष्णाः साधयेयुः, आदीप्त.आवासान् निष्पतन्तं वा
lines_iast: saṅkaṭa.gatam agninā, dhānvana.gataṃ dhūmena, nidhāna.gataṃ rasena, toya.avagāḍhaṃ duṣṭa.grāhair udaka.caraṇair vā tīkṣṇāḥ sādhayeyuḥ, ādīpta.āvāsān niṣpatantaṃ vā

words.gloss: by contrivance and by the vāmana-contrivance

hindi: योग और वामन-योग के द्वारा, अथवा किसी अन्य योग के द्वारा, ऊपर कही गई भूमियों में फँसे हुए शत्रु को वह छल से पराजित करे।
english: By contrivance and by the vāmana-contrivance, or by any other contrivance, he should outwit the enemy caught in the grounds stated above.
notes: Concluding verse (śloka). yoga-vāmana-yoga is obscure: taken as the dual of two items, 'yoga' (secret contrivance) and 'vāmana-yoga' (a contrivance named vāmana, perhaps 'that which expels'); another reading takes vāmana as 'reverse, counter'. Translation of this member is tentative.
lines_deva: योग.वामन.योगाभ्यां योगेन-अन्यतमेन वा
अमित्रम् अतिसन्दध्यात् सक्तम् उक्तासु भूमिषु
lines_iast: yoga.vāmana.yogābhyāṃ yogena-anyatamena vā
amitram atisandadhyāt saktam uktāsu bhūmiṣu
